items.summary: An integer overflow in the Onigmo regex engine used to compile regular expressions in GitLab CI/CD configuration files allows unauthenticated remote code execution on self-managed GitLab instances that allow self-registration and public projects. Fixed in GitLab 19.2.8, 19.3.5 and 19.4.2; CISA added it to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on October 29, with a November 1 remediation date for federal agencies.

The Gravity Forms plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP object injection in all versions up to and including 3.1.2, via a Post Custom Field whose input type is List. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit the deserialization flaw; update Gravity Forms to a fixed release.

Improperly controlled modification of dynamically-determined object attributes in the Drupal Block AJAX module allows PHP object injection, affecting Block AJAX versions from 0.0.0 to 3.0.2. Update Block AJAX to a version beyond 3.0.2.

Memory corruption in GarbageCollection in Google Chrome prior to 156.0.8078.79 allowed a remote attacker to potentially execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. Update Chrome to 156.0.8078.79 or later.

A PHP memory-corruption flaw in out-of-memory handling (PHP2Shell) can leave request memory in an unsafe state and allow unauthenticated remote code execution on PHP installations serving web requests. CISA added it to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on October 26; update to PHP 8.2.35, 8.3.36, 8.4.27 or 8.5.12.
